subject: Expansion request: enable additional squads and Q1 rate-class discussion
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jmeyers@apexlabs.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Apex Labs Procurement <procurement@apexlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request: enable additional squads and Q1 rate-class discussion

Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. We wrapped up a cross-org review and three additional squads (Search, Recommendations, and Compliance) want to start using Redwood next quarter. Current prod usage is under your existing tenant. Before we spin them up we need clarity on:

- Ability to issue separate API keys per squad and limit scopes
- Estimated incremental cost (tokens/month) for each new squad at pilot scale (10k req/day)
- Any onboarding windows or required lead time for dedicated capacity changes

Procurement also asked whether we can lock Q1 pricing for the initial six months if we increase committed capacity by 30%. Attaching a short roster of the squads and primary stakeholders.

Appreciate a quick rundown — Jordan
Apex Labs — Director, ML Platforms

---

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Jordan Meyers <jmeyers@apexlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request: enable additional squads and Q1 rate-class discussion

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front, then next steps:

- Separate API keys per squad: yes. We can issue distinct key namespaces and apply per-key quota and role restrictions.
- Cost estimate: rough baseline attached (CSV) — for pilot (10k req/day) we estimate ~0.9–1.3M tokens/month per squad depending on prompt length and model choice; I can run a quick model mix if you tell me which models the squads prefer.
- Lead time: for dedicated capacity changes, plan for 3–5 business days for soft capacity increases and 2–3 weeks for reserved GPU pool changes if you require strict SLA guarantees.

About pricing: we can offer a Q1 rate-class commitment for six months if Apex increases committed monthly units by 30% over your existing baseline. I'll loop in Laura for contract language and Monica for onboarding schedule.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben/Monica run token projection runbook for three squads (by Wed).
2) Internal Mx: send a mutually agreed mutual action plan (MAP) and proposed amendment to your PO (Laura).
3) Schedule a 30-min uplift call to walk procurement through the keys and governance model (this week).

Available slots: Tue 11/16 10:00–11:30 or Wed 11/17 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for you?

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

Hi Jordan —

Looping in procurement lane and sharing a draft amendment. Highlights:

- Adds a new Schedule A with squad-level API key provisioning and a clause for per-key quota enforcement.
- Adds a temporary Q1 rate-class for six months with volume-based tiering (30% uplift threshold to qualify).
- Includes a one-time onboarding credit to cover work for provisioning and tenant governance (covers setup and one policy workshop).

I've attached a redline (PDF) for your review. If procurement is comfortable, we can fast-track a signed amendment and have Monica start provisioning next week.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura —

Procurement reviewed the redline. Two quick asks:
1) Can we add a short SLA exception that guarantees soft burst capacity for the first 45 days after activation? We won't need a full reserved pool yet, but we want predictable burst behavior during ramp.
2) Can the onboarding credit be converted to a services credit applied to overage in month 1 if we overshoot the forecast? That makes finance happy.

If you can confirm those points, Procurement is ready to sign. Also confirming Wed 11/17 14:00 PT works for the call.

Jordan
